title: Understanding the Position Function
text: This represents a helical path where the particle moves in a circle in the xy-plane while moving linearly along the $$z\text{-axis}$$.

title: Finding the Velocity Vector
text: To find the velocity vector, differentiate the position function with respect to time $$t$$.

title: Calculate the Velocity Vector
text: Differentiate $$\vec{r}(t)=\cos(1.0t)\hat{i}+\sin(1.0t)\hat{j}+t\hat{k}$$ with respect to $$t$$ to find the velocity vector $$\vec{v}(t)$$.

title: Finding the Acceleration Vector
text: To find the acceleration vector, differentiate the velocity vector with respect to time $$t$$.

title: Calculate the Acceleration Vector
text: Differentiate $$\vec{v}(t)=-\sin(1.0t)\hat{i}+\cos(1.0t)\hat{j}+\hat{k}$$ with respect to $$t$$ to find the acceleration vector $$\vec{a}(t)$$.
